resolved.title: Resolved operational state
resolved.description: Afenda does not add another layer of interpretation. It resolves the state the business can operate, defend, and reconcile against.
resolved.body: The accepted state is tenant-bounded, actor-bound, policy-tested, and connected to the evidence required to explain why it exists.

auditPosture.value: Produced by operation, not reconstructed later

consequence.label: Business consequence
consequence.title: No narrative rescue after the fact.
consequence.body: The system forces truth to be produced at the moment of operation, so finance, audit, management, and execution work from the same resolved record.

system.title: Afenda is not a feature surface. It is the canonical layer beneath operational judgment.
system.description: The product exists to prevent the familiar enterprise failure: useful activity spread across tools, but no single accountable record strong enough for decision, audit, and control.

recordDiscipline.label: Record discipline
recordDiscipline.title: Every operational event resolves into a governed source of truth.
recordDiscipline.body: Afenda treats documents, entities, actions, approvals, and state transitions as durable business facts, not as disconnected interface activity.

evidenceBinding.label: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.title: The system keeps proof close to the decision it supports.
evidenceBinding.body: A decision without lineage is only a claim. Afenda binds actor, time, tenant, source, reason, and resulting state into a traceable operating layer.

resolutionControl.label: Resolution control
resolutionControl.title: Conflicting activity is resolved by policy, not by memory.
resolutionControl.body: When systems disagree, the operating model needs precedence, auditability, and controlled mutation. Afenda is built around that discipline.

topology.title: A single pipeline from raw signal to defensible record.
topology.description: Afenda does not scatter truth across tools. Inputs are normalized, evaluated in a resolution core, and emitted as canonical state with audit visibility.
topology.thesis: If the organization cannot draw this line on one diagram, it does not have one operating truth—only contested interpretations.

identity.title: Identity signals
identity.body: Actors, tenants, and ownership context as first-class facts.

skills.title: Capability graph
skills.body: Skills, proficiency, and workforce structure as governed attributes.

activity.title: Execution telemetry
activity.body: Workflow, document, and HRIS events with source and timestamp.

knowledge.title: Knowledge objects
knowledge.body: Artifacts and learning records bound to scope and policy.

identityBinding.title: Identity binding
identityBinding.body: Every transition is actor- and tenant-bound before policy runs.

policyResolution.title: Policy resolution
policyResolution.body: Authority, precedence, and rules decide what state may change.

evidenceCommit.title: Evidence commit
evidenceCommit.body: Proof is attached as the record is written—not recreated later.

record.label: Canonical record

visibility.label: Governed visibility
visibility.value: Role-scoped views of the same underlying record.

audit.label: Audit trail
audit.value: Traceable path from signal to accepted state.

consequence.label: Design consequence
consequence.title: No parallel authority.
consequence.body: If a channel can change business truth without traversing this spine, Afenda deliberately does not count it as governed.

surface.title: The interface is reduced to what the organization must know, prove, and control.
surface.description: No decorative dashboards. No synthetic theatre. The operational surface exists to expose canonical records, policy decisions, evidence links, and state movement.

integrationReality.title: External systems contribute signals. Afenda retains authority.
integrationReality.description: ERP, HRIS, identity, and collaboration tools remain sources—not competing ledgers of truth. Every inbound path crosses identity scope, normalization, governance, and commit discipline.
integrationReality.quote: An integration proves what entered the boundary—not what the business is allowed to believe.

knowledge.title: Knowledge & documents

governance.title: Governance enforcement
governance.body: Rule packs, approval chains, break-glass, and drift detection applied before state advances.

boundary.description: Each stage is mandatory. Skipping a stage is not a configuration option—it is a failed integration contract.

consequence.label: Operating rule
consequence.title: Integrations do not get a side door to truth.
consequence.body: If a vendor or shadow workflow cannot present the same receipt, it is not part of the governed operating model—regardless of UI convenience.

input.title: Events enter as evidence-bearing facts.
input.description: Documents, actions, integrations, identities, and state changes are captured with enough context to be judged later.

control.title: Policy determines authority and precedence.
control.description: The system evaluates tenant scope, role authority, source reliability, and rule bindings before state is allowed to move.

truth.title: A canonical record is resolved and retained.
truth.description: The resulting state becomes inspectable, auditable, and usable across the organization without relying on manual explanation.

domains.title: Capabilities are expressed as enterprise controls, not feature cards.
domains.description: Each domain answers one question: what can the organization rely on when operational pressure, system disagreement, and audit scrutiny arrive together?

canonicalRecords.title: Canonical records
canonicalRecords.body: Operational entities, documents, events, and transitions are normalized into accountable records with stable ownership, scope, and identity.
canonicalRecords.proof: Reduces duplicate truth surfaces and prevents record drift across teams, tools, and tenants.

evidenceBinding.title: Evidence binding
evidenceBinding.body: Every material state carries the proof required to defend it: source, actor, timestamp, reason, tenant boundary, and decision path.
evidenceBinding.proof: Turns operational claims into inspectable facts before audit pressure arrives.

governanceControls.title: Governance controls
governanceControls.body: Policy, role, approval, precedence, and exception handling are treated as first-class controls rather than implementation comments.
governanceControls.proof: Keeps operational change inside a controlled spine instead of relying on informal process memory.

auditContinuity.title: Audit continuity
auditContinuity.body: The system preserves the path from original event to current state, including reversals, overrides, and resolution authority.
auditContinuity.proof: Supports executive review, regulatory inspection, and internal accountability without narrative reconstruction.

operationalResolution.title: Operational resolution
operationalResolution.body: When incoming facts conflict, Afenda resolves them through declared precedence, tenant scope, and evidence quality.
operationalResolution.proof: Prevents the business from manually negotiating which system should be believed.

enterpriseIntegration.title: Enterprise integration
enterpriseIntegration.body: External systems connect as sources and consumers of truth, not as uncontrolled parallel ledgers.
enterpriseIntegration.proof: Allows ERP, identity, document, and workflow systems to participate without fragmenting authority.

commercial.title: Procurement-ready without procurement theatre.
commercial.description: Afenda aligns legal, security, and implementation reviewers on the same architectural facts: bounded authority, retained evidence, and a single canonical record posture.

governance.title: Governance artifacts
governance.body: Control matrix, DPIA scaffolding, segregation model, retention map—exported from live configuration.

implementation.title: Implementation playbook
implementation.body: Phased onboarding with explicit rollback, validation gates, and success criteria tied to canonical records.

security.title: Security evidence
security.body: Secret rotation, SSO binding, immutable audit lineage, anomaly routing documented—not claimed.

commercial.title: Commercial structure
commercial.body: Capacity, support tiers, and liability boundaries expressed against actual feature controls—no shelfware SKUs.

process.title: From first conversation to governed production
process.description: Each step produces a signed artifact. No step relies on narrative hand-waving.

consequence.label: Commercial consequence
consequence.title: The contract cites the architecture—not the slideware.
consequence.body: When dispute or audit arrives, both parties trace obligations to enumerated controls and immutable records—not to reinterpreted marketing claims.

guarantees.title: Credibility comes from what the system can prove under pressure.
guarantees.description: The guarantee is not speed, dashboards, or generic automation. The guarantee is that the organization can inspect how an operational state became true.

canonicalState.title: One canonical state
canonicalState.body: The business does not need three reports and a meeting to decide which record is true.

decisionPath.title: Traceable decision path
decisionPath.body: Every material decision can be followed through actor, source, policy, reason, and resulting state.

tenantBounded.title: Tenant-bounded records
tenantBounded.body: Records remain scoped to the correct tenant, legal entity, operating boundary, and authority model.

auditReady.title: Audit-ready evidence
auditReady.body: Evidence is retained as part of the operational record, not collected later as a separate rescue exercise.

controlledChange.title: Controlled change
controlledChange.body: Overrides, exceptions, and reversals move through visible governance rather than hidden operational shortcuts.

integrationDiscipline.title: Integration discipline
integrationDiscipline.body: Connected systems exchange truth through controlled boundaries instead of becoming competing authorities.

evidence.title: Trust is a property of the record—not the slide deck.
evidence.description: Afenda makes evidence structural: identity binding, policy evaluation, canonical commit, and audit visibility are visible stages, not retrofitted notes.
evidence.quote: If it cannot be traced, it is not evidence—it is opinion.

panel.label: Evidence stack
panel.title: Four irreducible guarantees before truth is credited

identity.title: Identity binding
identity.body: Actor, tenant, session, timestamp, and scope are asserted before interpretation begins.

policy.title: Policy gate
policy.body: Rules, approvals, exemptions, and break-glass are evaluated with rationale captured.

record.title: Canonical commit
record.body: State transitions write durable facts with versioning and lineage hashes.

audit.title: Audit surface
audit.body: Inspectors see the path from originating event to defended outcome—nothing reconstructed offline.

auditPath.description: Each hop is cryptographic or operationally attested. Removing a hop invalidates the record.

consequence.label: Audit posture
consequence.title: Evidence debt compounds—Afenda amortizes it at write time.
consequence.body: Organizations that postpone evidence capture pay compound interest during every subsequent audit, dispute, or leadership transition. Structural evidence avoids that trajectory.

closing.title: The system either knows the truth, or the business negotiates it manually.
closing.description: Afenda is designed for the former: a governed truth layer where operational records survive growth, integration pressure, tenant complexity, and executive review without requiring narrative rescue.

readiness.title: Enterprise adoption begins with evidence, scope, and operating discipline.
readiness.description: These are the questions the product is built to answer before procurement, rollout, or executive sponsorship creates pressure.

replacement.question: What does Afenda replace?
replacement.answer: Afenda does not begin as a replacement for ERP, document storage, or workflow tools. It establishes the truth layer that governs how operational facts become reliable records across those systems.

start.question: Where does implementation start?
start.answer: Implementation starts with the highest-risk truth surface: records where conflicting sources, manual reconciliation, approval ambiguity, or audit exposure already create operational cost.

integrations.question: How does Afenda handle integrations?
integrations.answer: Integrations are treated as governed sources and consumers. They are not allowed to silently create a second authority without identity, scope, precedence, and evidence rules.

enterpriseGrade.question: What makes this enterprise-grade?
enterpriseGrade.answer: The enterprise posture comes from tenant boundaries, evidence retention, audit continuity, policy-driven state transitions, and a product model that treats control as architecture rather than an afterthought.

executiveReview.question: How should executives evaluate the product?
executiveReview.answer: Evaluate whether Afenda can explain who changed what, why it changed, which source was trusted, whose authority applied, when the state became true, and how the evidence survives review.

executiveClose.title: The next step is an architecture review—not another demo.
executiveClose.description: Afenda publishes the same ontology to procurement, builders, auditors, and operators. Decide whether one structural truth spine is preferable to escalating reconciliation cost.

governance.title: Governance dossier
governance.body: Policy packs, RACI overlays, segregation diagrams, DPIA scaffolding—exported as versioned bundles.

review.title: Red-team review memo
review.body: Third-party pen-test deltas, cryptographic controls, anomaly kill-chain drill results.

close.label: Decision checkpoint
close.title: No remaining architectural unknowns?
close.body: If any item is still “to be defined in implementation,” the review is not complete—scale does not fix ambiguous controls.
